req.title: Task update rejects id changes
req.statement: The system shall ignore any id field in the PUT body and only mutate the task addressed by the URL.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-038 requires that when a PUT /tasks/{id} request body contains an 'id' field, the system ignores it and mutates only the task addressed by the URL path parameter. Tests must verify: (1) positive — a body with a different id value still updates the correct task and the response id matches the URL id; (2) negative — the body id cannot hijack a different task's identity; (3) boundary — body id equal to URL id is a no-op on identity; (4) additional EP/DT cases covering the id-ignore behaviour with various field combinations. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact response id values, exact HTTP status codes, and verifying the original task at the alternate id is untouched.

tests.name: test_put_body_id_ignored_response_id_matches_url
preconditions: Task with id=1 exists in the database (title='Read chapter 5', completed=true)
Task with id=99 does NOT exist in the database
actions: Send PUT /tasks/1 with JSON body {"id": 99, "title": "Updated Title", "completed": false}
Inspect response status code and body
expected: Response body id == 1 (URL id, not body id 99)
tests.executable:
import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from app.database import Base, engine
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.database import SessionLocal
from app import models

client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_body_id_ignored_response_id_matches_url():
    db = SessionLocal()
    db.query(models.Task).delete()
    task = models.Task(id=1, title='Read chapter 5', completed=True)
    db.add(task)
    db.commit()
    db.close()
    r = client.put('/tasks/1', json={'id': 99, 'title': 'Updated Title', 'completed': False})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == 1
    assert body['title'] == 'Updated Title'
    assert body['completed'] == False

test_put_body_id_ignored_response_id_matches_url()

tests.name: test_put_body_id_does_not_mutate_alternate_task
preconditions: Task with id=2 exists (title='Book flight tickets')
actions: Send PUT /tasks/1 with JSON body {"id": 2, "title": "Hijacked", "completed": true}
Then GET /tasks/2 to verify task 2 is untouched
expected: PUT returns HTTP 200 with id==1 in body
GET /tasks/2 returns HTTP 200 with title still 'Book flight tickets' (unchanged)
tests.executable:
import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from app.database import Base, engine
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.database import SessionLocal
from app import models

client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_body_id_does_not_mutate_alternate_task():
    db = SessionLocal()
    db.query(models.Task).delete()
    db.add(models.Task(id=1, title='Read chapter 5', completed=True))
    db.add(models.Task(id=2, title='Book flight tickets', completed=True))
    db.commit()
    db.close()
    r = client.put('/tasks/1', json={'id': 2, 'title': 'Hijacked', 'completed': True})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json()['id'] == 1
    assert r.json()['title'] == 'Hijacked'
    r2 = client.get('/tasks/2')
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert r2.json()['id'] == 2
    assert r2.json()['title'] == 'Book flight tickets'

test_put_body_id_does_not_mutate_alternate_task()

tests.name: test_put_nonexistent_url_id_returns_404_regardless_of_body_id
preconditions: Task with id=50 does NOT exist
actions: Send PUT /tasks/50 with JSON body {"id": 1, "title": "Ghost Update", "completed": false}
expected: Task with id=1 is NOT modified
tests.executable:
import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from app.database import Base, engine
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.database import SessionLocal
from app import models

client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_nonexistent_url_id_returns_404_regardless_of_body_id():
    db = SessionLocal()
    db.query(models.Task).delete()
    db.add(models.Task(id=1, title='Read chapter 5', completed=True))
    db.commit()

    r = client.put('/tasks/50', json={'id': 1, 'title': 'Ghost Update', 'completed': False})
